name: Santa María de la Vega (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over green, charged with a circle of twelve five-pointed stars, blue on the white and white on the green.
history: The heraldic arms and the flag were approved in 2006 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 30 January 2006; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of two equal horizontal stripes, white above and green below, with twelve five-pointed stars in a circle, blue those on the white stripe and white those on the green stripe.

features.role: circle of twelve stars, blue on the white stripe and white on the green stripe
